price_information: Current whole-day prices assumed released before daily dispatch; future forecasts use past revealed prices only.
event_information: Only supplier status at each daily boundary; unknown actual future return. Single onset and repair at day boundaries; onset first known by observation.
optimization: 72h native service horizon, first24h PWL cost; credit certificates as policy-specific. After a failure, latched service-first remaining-episode emergency. Tail power is a forecast-cost surrogate.
